narrative:
## Handover Summary — Revenue Planning

Revenue targets validated across all segments and entities. Agent proposals reviewed and accepted or overridden by planners.

## Key Decisions
• Germany plan re-phased towards its forecast run-rate (EUR 0.1B)
• Türkiye upside of EUR 0.3B kept in the forecast, not yet in targets

## Recommendation for COGS Phase
Model Network, Energy & Site Costs against the updated volume trajectory first — it is 38% of COGS.

signals.title: Energy and network inflation is the largest margin swing
signals.source: SDP Scenario Analysis — base growth × ARPU × efficiency × energy
signals.excerpt: In the scenario model, energy and network cost inflation moves operating profit more than any other lever; a price war combined with an energy spike is the downside case.
